The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the tenth season of {{aniseries|PTS}}, ''[[S10|Pokémon: Diamond and Pearl]]'', in {{pmin|the United States}} and {{pmin|Canada}} ({{wp|DVD region code|DVD Region 1}}). ==Volume releases== Three ''Pokémon: Diamond and Pearl'' DVD box sets were released by [[VIZ Media]] in 2008 and 2009, containing the whole season between them. There are three boxed sets each containing two volumes with one disc each. The volumes were sold both individually and as part of the box sets. Optional English closed captioning is included on the DVDs. ===Box Set 1: Episodes 1-17=== [[File:Diamond and Pearl Box 1 Cover.png|thumb|200px|Pokémon: Diamond and Pearl - Box Set 1]] Pokémon: Diamond and Pearl - Box Set 1 was released by [[VIZ Media]] on September 16, 2008. It contains two discs with 17 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is DPMDPBS1. The contained volumes were released for individual sale on the same day as the box set. {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{colorschemelight|Sinnoh}}; border: 3px solid #{{colorschemedark|Sinnoh}}; {{roundy|10px}};" !
